text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp, the final day. As the bus departure time drew near,
she was nowhere to be seen, so I decided to look for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Making an educated guess, I head toward that location, and—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"I've gained speed. And I can lift
considerably heavier dumbbells now too."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, Trainer!
I didn't notice you. Why are you here—"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could it be that
it's about time for the bus to leave?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I see, thank you.
I was strictly warned not to miss it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, we found it pretty quickly, so there was
no need to rush. When I told her that—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh, really? Are you finally learning to predict my actions?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps because I had accompanied her on walks... the kind of scenery Mr. C.B. liked may have been imprinted into my mind.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's play hide-and-seek.
I'm actually pretty good at hiding, you know.
choice_data_list: Even so, we don't have enough time for—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"The 'it' has to close their eyes!
Ready, set, go!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In any case, and so...
the turbulent summer training camp came to a close.
